notes.content: Agreement Information The information below represents a view of articulated lower-division courses between California State University, Long Beach (CSULB) and the sending institution, aligning with the CSULB Academic Catalog. Important Admissions Information for Fall 2027 ALL MAJORS ARE IMPACTED at California State University, Long Beach.
